question: What consequence follows from fasting by day in this practice?
premises: This practice affects aging and death
inference: By fasting during the day, one will go to the death of age
uncertainties: The phrase vayo-mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous and may mean overcoming or reaching age-death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to the death of age.
